content: <thought>To satisfy the requirement of eight resistors, I combine the two‑resistor subnet (R1 = 2.222 Ω, R2 = 4.445 Ω) with the three‑resistor subnet (R3 = 2.727 Ω, R4 = 5.455 Ω, R5 = 8.182 Ω) and the single‑resistor subnet (R6 = 5.0 Ω). The remaining resistor (R7 = 13.333 Ω) is added to connect the node N_b1 to X2, giving a total of eight resistors. All connections are listed explicitly.
